environment.database: new isolated temporary SQLite databases, never production
environment.accounts: two fictitious employee accounts in the local HTTP validation harness
environment.drive: simulated by the harness; pages store no files in Drive

automated.pages_dom: passed: editing, autosave, safe preview, offline draft, conflict, share, history, idle, revocation
automated.channels_dom: passed: channels, access, read-only, reads, notifications, threads, tasks, media and revision purge
automated.chat_dom: passed: private entry, images, audio, forwarding, selection, partial failures and retry
automated.production_build: passed after clean npm ci; pre-existing large Sheets chunks warning

browser_http.two_identity_stale_revision_conflict: passed: later draft retained, explicit resolution saved a new version
browser_http.history_and_restore: passed: both authors retained in history; restore created a new version
browser_http.deep_link: passed: authenticated new tab opened the intended channel page
browser_http.module_exit_guard: passed: cancelling Chat navigation retained the page draft
browser_http.themes: light and dark inspected; dark accent uses a lighter semantic color
browser_http.mobile_portrait: 375px: one-pane page navigation, no horizontal overflow
browser_http.mobile_landscape: 812x375px: no horizontal overflow; outer main scroll and 320px page pane keep editor reachable
browser_http.reduced_motion: enabled during responsive checks; no required animation
browser_http.toolbar_touch_targets: measured at least 44px height and width for icon actions

privacy_and_cost.task_references: live authorization in current and historical content; unavailable title/id not projected
privacy_and_cost.page_save_events: no message unread increment and no unread-summary refresh; no periodic page polling
privacy_and_cost.history: immutable full snapshots; no silent overwrite or permanent deletion
privacy_and_cost.limits: 200 blocks and 100000 serialized bytes per normalized page
privacy_and_cost.drafts: memory-only; no forced-close recovery guarantee; revoked access purges private state

remaining: Run the eight concurrency contracts on explicitly isolated PostgreSQL before production acceptance.
